data.title: Yearly Timeline: Ordering the events of a school day

challenges.title: School Year Milestones
challenges.instruction: Place these fun school events in the correct order from the start of the year to the end.

events.label: First Day of School
events.description: Meet your new teacher and classmates in August.

events.label: Fall Picture Day
events.description: Smile for the camera in October.

events.label: Winter Holiday Show
events.description: Sing songs on stage in December.

events.label: 100th Day of School
events.description: Celebrate learning a lot in February.

events.label: Field Day
events.description: Play fun games outside in May.

challenges.hint: Think about when the school year begins and when it finishes.
challenges.narration: Let's organize the big moments of our school year!

challenges.title: Seasons and Nature
challenges.instruction: Arrange these outdoor changes in order from the beginning of the year to the end.

events.label: Snowy Winter Mornings
events.description: Wear heavy coats and boots in January.

events.label: Spring Flowers Bloom
events.description: Green grass and colorful plants grow in April.

events.label: Sunny Summer Days
events.description: Go swimming and play outside in July.

events.label: Falling Leaves
events.description: Watch the trees turn orange and brown in October.

events.label: First Winter Frost
events.description: See crisp white ice on the grass in December.

challenges.hint: Watch how the weather changes outside as the months go by.
challenges.narration: How does nature change throughout the year?

challenges.title: Fun Annual Holidays
challenges.instruction: Put these special celebration days in order from earliest to latest.

events.label: Groundhog Day
events.description: Check to see if winter will stay in February.

events.label: Earth Day
events.description: Plant trees and clean up our park in April.

events.label: Labor Day
events.description: Enjoy a long weekend at the start of September.

events.label: Veterans Day
events.description: Honor brave heroes in November.

events.label: New Year's Eve
events.description: Count down to midnight on the last day of December.

challenges.hint: Start with winter celebrations and work your way toward the end of the year.
challenges.narration: Can you order these holidays correctly?

challenges.title: Sports and Club Activities
challenges.instruction: Order these after-school activities from the first one in the year to the last.

events.label: Indoor Basketball
events.description: Play hoops in the gymnasium during February.

events.label: Track and Field
events.description: Run races and jump hurdles in May.

events.label: Summer Swim Team
events.description: Practice swimming laps in July.

events.label: Flag Football
events.description: Play team sports on the crisp field in October.

events.label: Holiday Food Drive
events.description: Collect cans for neighbors in November.

challenges.hint: Think about when spring sports and fall sports happen.
challenges.narration: Let's track our sports and club fun through the year!
